scope: GDN core from raw convolution Q/K/V and gate projections to output plus recurrent state; other operators have separate contracts.
selection: Pinned stock vLLM packed single-token GDN, applied causally to each materialized token. R4D and NumPy remain separately identified implementations.

domain.inputs: Finite BF16 Q/K/V, a, b, dt_bias; finite FP32 A_log and initial state. Invalid geometry, aliasing, nonfinite output/state or incomplete evidence fails closed.

precision.qk_normalization: FP32 throughout; no intermediate BF16 cast
precision.beta: sigmoid in the pinned FP32 kernel, then BF16 round-to-nearest ties-even, then exact FP32 widening
precision.recurrent_state: FP32 on every read, update and committed write

operations.name: normalize
operations.arithmetic: Pinned compiled reduction, square root and division. No replacement with a differently rounded reciprocal-square-root multiply.

operations.name: scale_query
operations.arithmetic: Scale q before the output dot product; not after it.

operations.name: gates
operations.formula: x = float32(a + dt_bias); softplus = x if x > 20 else log(1 + exp(x)); g = -exp(A_log)*softplus; beta = widen(BF16_RNE(sigmoid(b)))
operations.arithmetic: The pinned kernel intrinsics and their compiled implementations define rounding. No cumulative-gate reconstruction or future-dependent fallback.

operations.name: state
operations.arithmetic: Retain the compiled multiply-add contraction; separate multiply/add is a different numerical path.

arithmetic_authority.note: Real-number formulae describe dataflow. Exact finite-precision results are defined by the retained kernel artifact and packing below, under the declared compiler/hardware assumptions. Source inspection or matching hashes is not proof of runtime dispatch or functional correctness.

packing.note: Single row makes the packed-QKV row stride irrelevant to this invocation. Reject or separately qualify other physical packing; physical block numbers are not semantic state.

execution_modes.m1: One invocation F(S,u) with exactly one materialized input token.
execution_modes.prefill: Ordered fold of that same F over tokens. Empty segment is the identity. Every intermediate prefix must match.
execution_modes.d7: Verification rows are u[0]=previously emitted pending token, u[1:8]=seven proposals. For accepted proposal count k in 0..7, commit the state after rows 0..k (k+1 processed rows); the newly emitted correction/bonus token stays pending.
execution_modes.rollback: Rejected rows cannot affect committed GDN state, convolution history, KV, positions or events. The GDN-only contract does not certify those other components.
execution_modes.snapshot: Persist the contract identity with state; do not treat states created under a different arithmetic contract as interchangeable without checking or rebuilding.

obligations.partition: fold(F,S,A+B) == fold(F,fold(F,S,A).state,B) for outputs and state, including empty segments
obligations.causal_prefix: Changing inputs after prefix p leaves every output/state through p byte-identical.
obligations.accepted_prefix: D7_commit(S,u,k) == fold(F,S,u[:k+1]).state with a separate pending-token field.
obligations.exactness: Compare BF16 output bits and every FP32 logical-state bit; hashes and error tolerances alone do not establish equality.

separate_targets.numpy-serial-fp32-v1: Independent canonical model. It rounds normalized Q/K to BF16, uses ordered non-fused reductions and scales the final output dot. It is not relabelled as this stock kernel.
separate_targets.r4d-unfused-m1: Retains FP32 beta, uses its own reduction/normalization intrinsics, disables FMA and rounds output ties away. Existing prefill candidate targets this path, not this contract.
separate_targets.huggingface-fallback: The pinned Transformers fallback also returns BF16 beta, but its normalization and framework reductions differ. Full bit equality with it is UNPROVED.

required_qualification: Reproduce the preserved stock first transition exactly with the selected invocation packing.
Compare repaired prefill/M1/D7 against this oracle from equal independent initial state.
Exercise every accepted width, all-prefix equality, future-suffix mutations, padding, nonzero state, extreme gates and BF16 halfway boundaries.
Then qualify graph execution, full-model logits/state, snapshots and long contexts; benchmark separately.
